senses.sense_definition: A straight line that a curve approaches closer and closer as it moves toward infinity.

examples.text: The graph of the function has a vertical <w>asymptote</w> at x equals zero.
As the curve approaches its <w>asymptote</w>, the distance between them becomes negligible.

senses.sense_definition: Something that comes very close to another thing but never actually touches it.

examples.text: Their friendship was an <w>asymptote</w>, always drawing near but never truly becoming a romantic relationship.
Perfect justice is an <w>asymptote</w> that society constantly strives to reach.

senses.sense_definition: To approach a line or value increasingly closely without ever reaching it.

examples.text: The growth rate <w>asymptotes</w> toward a maximum capacity as resources become limited.
The curve <w>asymptotes</w> to the x-axis as the value of x increases.
